summary: Backend-only verification of TBS CTS SOAP namespace bug fix. Ran pytest on /app/backend/tests/test_gohub_client.py — all 11/11 tests passed including the 3 targeted parse tests (attribute-based status success, non-OK status raises, invalid-IP live-shape). Confirmed backend /api/health OK, admin login returns access_token, /api/admin/routes returns a list, /api/admin/terminals returns terminals list. Dry-run default (GOHUB_ENABLED=false) verified — client short-circuits with mocked OK payload.
critical_code_review_comments: gohub_client.py correctly uses CTS_NAMESPACE https://eticketing.tbsbts.com.my/ws_cts in envelope xmlns and SOAPAction header.
_parse_response now correctly reads status/msg as XML attributes on <{op}_status>, matching live CTS response shape.
Dry-run mode gated properly by GOHUB_ENABLED env flag (default false).
context_for_next_testing_agent: GoHub/CTS SOAP client tests all pass (11/11). Live TBS endpoint is IP-whitelisted so cannot be tested from Emergent cluster — respx mocks used. Admin regression flows healthy.
